info.name: Skillso — Courses & Tracking (Complete)
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for Skillso LMS course browsing, student progress tracking, and admin/instructor monitoring.

## Setup
1. Import this file into Postman
2. Set collection variables:
   - `base_url` — Laravel API root
   - `user_token` — student token (from User Login)
   - `admin_token` — admin token (from Admin Login)
   - `instructor_token` — instructor token (optional)
   - `course_id`, `chapter_id`, `lecture_id`, `user_id`, `quiz_id`, `attempt_id`, `enrollment_id`

## Admin tracking flow
1. `GET /api/admin/tracking` — all students × courses
2. `GET /api/admin/courses/enrollment-overview` — per-course stats
3. `GET /api/admin/courses/{id}/student-progress` — students in one course
4. `GET /api/admin/courses/{id}/students/{user_id}/details` — deep dive
5. `GET /api/reports/students/{id}` — full student report
